<a id="device_not_present"></a>
### [`device_not_present`](../../../../src/storage/storage_data_2df1.asm#L8) `$2E0A-$2E0E`

*data*

Script: writes "Device Not Present" to drive_message. Used by storage_device_absent, and by check_drive_status ($3b37) when the drive does not answer.
